summary: Build practical skills for AI job redesign, reskilling, redeployment, and responsible workforce transitions. Enrol for the five-day course.
lede: AI workforce redesign helps HR leaders, workforce planners, and transformation teams assess how automation changes tasks, roles, and skills. The training covers mapping automation exposure, identifying skills gaps and role adjacencies, and modelling reskilling or redeployment pathways. Participants also practise redesigning role profiles, planning employee consultation, assessing workforce risks, and reporting transition outcomes to executives.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders who must connect AI adoption decisions with job architecture, workforce capacity, employee relations, and measurable transition outcomes across complex organizations.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in HR, workforce planning, organizational transformation, operations, employee relations, or people analytics. No coding or AI model development is required. Familiarity with organizational structures, job descriptions, workforce data, or change initiatives will help you apply the exercises. Bring a representative role profile or anonymized workforce scenario if available.
